targets.cindy: Cindy app: skills from ~/.agents/skills, plugins from sync/cindy-plugins.json
targets.opendesign: OpenDesign: the opendesign-trial Cindy plugin plus prompts/system/opendesign-ui-code-audit.md

notes: One collection for every computer. A skill is installed from its source on each computer; foreign content is never copied into this repository.
install.method tells how a skill reaches a computer: repository-copy, git-sparse-checkout, or manual when the upstream is not verified.
harnesses lists every agent that sees the skill once it is installed in install.root.
machines and gaps are coverage evidence: what was seen where and what a computer still needs. They are not separate collections.
cindyPlugins install from the Cindy marketplace on each computer and are authorized there; sync/cindy-plugins.json lists what each one needs.
opendesign-trial is the OpenDesign plugin; OpenDesign also uses prompts/system/opendesign-ui-code-audit.md.
appManaged entries ship inside Cindy or Codex and are never copied.
